properties.name: Harappa
properties.excavator: Daya Ram Sahni & Sir John Marshall (1921)
properties.key_finds: Great Granary (12 units), Cemetery R-37, Red sandstone male torso, Copper scale, Faience bangles
properties.description: The type-site of the Indus Civilization situated on the left bank of the Ravi river. Gave its name to the entire Harappan cultural horizon.
properties.citation: Archaeological Survey of India (ASI) & Vats, M.S. (1940)

properties.name: Mohenjo-daro (Mound of the Dead)
properties.key_finds: Great Bath, Granary, College of Priests, Bronze Dancing Girl, Steatite Priest-King statue, Pashupati seal
properties.description: The largest excavated Bronze Age metropolis in the Indus basin, showcasing monumental public civic architecture and an advanced covered drainage network.
properties.citation: Marshall, Sir John (1931, Mohenjo-daro and the Indus Civilization)

properties.name: Dholavira: A Harappan City
properties.key_finds: Monumental stone reservoirs (water harvesting), 10-symbol Indus Signboard, Tripartite urban plan (Citadel, Middle Town, Lower Town), Check dams on Manhar and Mansar streams
properties.description: Located on Khadir Bet island in the Rann of Kutch, Gujarat. Premier example of hydraulic engineering, stone masonry, and urban defense in the ancient world.
properties.citation: Archaeological Survey of India (ASI) Monograph / Bisht, R.S.

properties.name: Rakhigarhi
properties.key_finds: 11 Mounds covering >350 hectares, Mud-brick podiums, Gold foundry, Lapidary workshop, Intact DNA skeletal burials
properties.status: ASI Protected Monument of National Importance
properties.description: The largest known settlement of the Indus-Saraswati Civilization located in Hisar district, Haryana. Ancient paleochannel of the Drishadvati river.
properties.citation: ASI Excavation Reports & Shinde et al. (Cell, 2019)

properties.name: Lothal (Ancient Tidal Dockyard)
properties.key_finds: Tidal dockyard basin (214m x 36m) with sluice gate, Bead factory, Persian Gulf button seal, Dual burials
properties.description: World's earliest identified tidal dockyard connecting the Harappan heartland to Arabian Sea maritime trade channels at the head of the Gulf of Khambhat.
properties.citation: Rao, S.R. (Lothal and the Indus Civilization, 1973)

properties.name: Kalibangan (Black Bangles)
properties.key_finds: Earliest ploughed agricultural field surface (criss-cross furrows), Row of 7 brick fire-altars (sacrificial platforms)
properties.description: Situated on the dried bed of the Ghaggar (ancient Saraswati) in Hanumangarh district, Rajasthan. Shows transition from Early to Mature Harappan phases.

properties.name: Nalanda Mahavihara
properties.key_finds: Monasteries, Stupas, Temple No. 3, Inscribed seals of Harshavardhana and Devapala, Bronze Buddhist sculptures
properties.description: One of the greatest residential universities of the ancient world. Accommodated 10,000 scholars and 2,000 masters studying philosophy, astronomy, medicine, and logic.
properties.citation: Archaeological Survey of India & Xuanzang's Great Tang Records on the Western Regions

properties.name: Takshashila (Taxila)
properties.key_finds: Dharmarajika Stupa, Sirkap Greek-style city grid, Jaulian monastery, Silver scrolls, Indo-Greek coinage
properties.description: Legendary seat of Vedic and Buddhist intellectual learning where Chanakya authored the Arthashastra, Panini taught Sanskrit grammar, and Jivaka studied medicine.
properties.citation: Marshall, Sir John (Taxila: An Illustrated Account, 1951)

properties.name: Great Stupa at Sanchi
properties.excavator: Gen. Henry Taylor (1818) & Sir John Marshall (1912)
properties.key_finds: Great Stupa hemisphere, Four intricately carved Torana gateways depicting Jataka tales, Ashoka Pillar edict
properties.description: The oldest stone structure in India, commissioned by Emperor Ashoka over the holy relics of the Buddha in Raisen district, Madhya Pradesh.

properties.name: Sarnath (Isipatana Deer Park)
properties.key_finds: Lion Capital of Ashoka (National Emblem of India), Dhamek Stupa, Dharmarajika Stupa foundation, Preaching Buddha sculpture
properties.description: The sacred site where Gautama Buddha delivered his First Sermon (Dhammacakkappavattana Sutta) setting the Wheel of Law into motion.

properties.name: Mahabodhi Temple Complex at Bodh Gaya
properties.key_finds: Diamond Throne (Vajrasana) of Ashoka, Sacred Bodhi Tree (Ficus religiosa), 55m grand pyramidal brick temple
properties.description: The most sacred pilgrimage center of Buddhism, where Siddhartha Gautama attained supreme enlightenment under the Bodhi tree in Gaya district, Bihar.

properties.name: Ajanta Rock-Cut Caves
properties.key_finds: 30 rock-cut caves carved into horseshoe basalt cliff, Masterpiece Buddhist tempera murals (Padmapani & Vajrapani)
properties.description: Masterpieces of Buddhist religious art located in Chhatrapati Sambhaji Nagar district, Maharashtra, overlooking the Waghur river ravine.

properties.name: Ellora Caves & Kailash Temple
properties.key_finds: Cave 16 Kailasa Temple (world's largest monolithic rock excavation: 200,000 tonnes of basalt carved from the top down)
properties.description: 34 rock-cut sanctuaries honoring Hindu, Buddhist, and Jain traditions side-by-side, epitomizing the religious tolerance of classical India.
properties.citation: ASI Monograph & Fergusson / Burgess (The Cave Temples of India)

properties.name: Group of Monuments at Hampi (Vijayanagara)
properties.key_finds: Virupaksha Temple, Vijaya Vittala Stone Chariot, Queen's Bath, Lotus Mahal, Stepped Tank (Pushkarani)
properties.description: The grand imperial capital of the Vijayanagara Empire on the banks of the Tungabhadra river. Was the world's second-largest medieval city in 1500 CE.
properties.citation: Archaeological Survey of India & Longhurst (Hampi Ruins, 1917)

properties.name: Brihadisvara Temple, Thanjavur
properties.key_finds: 66m granite vimana tower, 80-tonne monolithic cupola (Kumbam), Massive monolithic Nandi (bull), Chola fresco paintings
properties.status: UNESCO World Heritage Site (Great Living Chola Temples)
properties.description: Peruvudaiyar Kovil, towering Dravidian architectural triumph constructed entirely of interlocking granite blocks without mortar.
properties.citation: Archaeological Survey of India (ASI) Southern Circle

properties.name: Sun Temple, Konark (Black Pagoda)
properties.key_finds: 24 colossal stone chariot wheels functioning as precision sundials, 7 stone horses, Kalinga chlorite sculptures
properties.description: Conceived as a colossal celestial chariot for Surya the Sun God emerging from the Bay of Bengal coast in Puri district, Odisha.

properties.name: Muziris (Pattanam Maritime Port)
properties.key_finds: Roman amphorae shards, Terra Sigillata, Chera coins, Carnelian intaglio seals, Wharf canoe wood (C-14 dated to 1st c. BCE)
properties.status: State Heritage Site / Muziris Heritage Project
properties.description: The celebrated ancient trans-oceanic spice port described in Sangam poetry and Pliny's Natural History as the destination of Roman pepper ships.
properties.citation: KCHR Pattanam Excavation Reports & Periplus of the Erythraean Sea

properties.name: Arikamedu (Podouke of Ptolemy)
properties.key_finds: Arretine pottery, Roman Mediterranean wine amphorae, Intaglio signet rings, Glass bead manufactory
properties.description: Coastal trading emporium near Puducherry on the Ariyankuppam river. Provided the first stratigraphic proof of Indo-Roman commerce in South India.
